Let $p(x)$ be a real polynomial of least degree which has a local maximum at $x = 1$ and a local minimum at $x = 3$. If $p(1) = 6$ and $p(3) = 2$, then $p'(0)$ is equal to
questions.solution:
Degree 3
$P'(x) = a(x - 1)(x - 3)$
$\Rightarrow P'(x) = a(x^{2} - 4x + 3) \Rightarrow P(x) = a\left(\frac{x^{3}}{3} - \frac{4x^{2}}{2} + 3x\right) + b$
$P(1) = 6 \Rightarrow a\left(\frac{1}{3} - 2 + 3\right) + b = 6 \Rightarrow \frac{4a}{3} + b = 6$
$\Rightarrow 4a + 3b = 18$ .........(i)
$\Rightarrow P(3) = 2 \Rightarrow a(9 - 18 + 9) + b = 2$
$\Rightarrow b = 2$ .....................(ii)
Put in (i) $\Rightarrow 4a + 6 = 18 \Rightarrow a = 3$
So, $p'(x) = 3(x - 1)(x - 3) \Rightarrow P'(0) = 9$

questions.stem: If E and F are two independent events with $P(E) = 0.3$ and $P(E \cup F) = 0.5$, then $P(E/F) - P(F/E)$ equals
questions.solution:
$P(E \cup F) = P(E) + P(F) - P(E \cap F)$
$\Rightarrow 0.5 = 0.3 + P(F) - P(E).P(F)$
$\Rightarrow 0.2 = P(F) - 0.3\,P(F)$
$\Rightarrow P(F) = \frac{2}{7}$
So, $P(E/F) - P(F/E) = P(E) - P(F) = \frac{3}{10} - \frac{2}{7} = \frac{21 - 20}{70} = \frac{1}{70}$

The number of reflexive relations on a set A of n elements is equal to
questions.solution:
Total number of ordered pair $= n^{2}$
Number of pair that can be included or excluded $= n^{2} - n$
Each of the remaining $n^{2} - n$ pairs we have two choices
Include it in the relation or not include it
So total no. of reflexive relation is $2^{n(n-1)}$
